appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Changes at once, no restart. The player is always dark

playback.autoplayHint: Playback stops at the end of a season
playback.speedHint: Every run of Kino starts with it
playback.volumeHint: Every run of Kino starts with it
playback.hwdecHint: Less CPU load for 4K and HEVC. Turn it off if the picture has artefacts

tracks.title: Audio and subtitles
tracks.hint: For a series, what you chose in its earlier episodes comes first
tracks.audioHint: If the file has none — as in the file
tracks.positionHint: For SRT and plain ASS; styled ASS place themselves

library.historyHint: Stop positions, viewings and frames. Stored on this computer only
library.foldersHint: Kino looks through them at start and adds new episodes itself

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.hint: Click a key in the table, then press the new one. Escape cancels
hotkeys.reserved: {{key}} cannot be assigned: Escape leaves fullscreen, Tab moves the focus
hotkeys.modifier: Shortcuts with Ctrl, Alt and Win are not assigned — press a single key

system.title: System
system.keepAwakeHint: Only while a video plays: the screen stays on, no sleep

reset.hint: History, series folders and remembered tracks stay
reset.title: Reset the settings?
reset.text: All settings, hotkeys included, return to the defaults.
